friends.title: Leaderboard & friend families
friends.description: A weekly leaderboard. Everyone gets a score out of 100: the share of their assigned chores' points that they earned. Bigger chores count for more, and families with different point values can still compete. Must-do and Every-day chores count; excused chores and paused days don't. Bonus chores only break ties.
friends.familiesDesc: Link with another family that runs OpenChore so the kids can share a leaderboard and visit each other's farms. The two homes never connect to each other: each one sends encrypted updates to a coordination server every 15 minutes, and the server can't read them.
friends.shareDesc: For each person you share, that family gets their first name, colour, their score and chore counts for this week and last, their streak, and their farm animal with how it's doing. Chore names, photos, point values, point balances and rewards are never sent. A custom animal picture is sent only after you approve it. Until you tick someone they offer, only that person's name is kept here.

friends.showPicturesDesc: Kids can use their own pictures as farm animals. With this off, a friend's animal shows as the built-in kind and their pictures aren't kept here. Your own kids' pictures are only sent once you tick "OK to send to friend families" under Farm pets.
friends.allowVisitsDesc: Kids can spend points to send a friend's animal a treat (it gets a little food and joy) or send their own animal over for the day. A visiting animal shows on your farm for signed-in family members, not on the wall display.
